entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker and mind-mage who is attempting to rewrite reality with his own vision for existence.

entities.name: The Theorist
entities.description: A fragmented version of Jace, an amalgamation of his worst traits, who builds the Echoverse from his sanctum in the tower and erases dissent.

entities.name: Honest Jace
aliases: the part of Jace that is honest
entities.description: The first piece the Theorist carved away, a memory-prison fragment of Jace that narrates the guide and regrets the plan.

entities.name: Guildpact Jace
aliases: the piece of Jace that was once the Guildpact
entities.description: A piece of Jace in a memory-prison who stands in the imaginary ruins of his former sanctum.

entities.name: Denzilore Fatehold
entities.description: An elder sphinx who founded the School of Future History to improve the outlook of the denizens of Arcavios.

entities.name: Uldaros Theorix
entities.description: An elder sphinx who used reality-bending magic to build the original fortress of Hexhaven.

entities.name: Ingris Stingerquill
entities.description: An elder sphinx who composed the canons of the School of Painful Words.

entities.name: Aerid Konstrari
entities.description: An elder sphinx born of red and green leylines who animates inert materials with a heartwood crystal.

entities.name: Kwia Vigorbloom
entities.description: An elder sphinx who emerged from the leyline confluence able to grow and manipulate plant matter.

entities.name: The Founder Sphinxes
entities.description: Five elder sphinxes, formed from harmonious mana, who founded Hexhaven Academy and now act as aloof deans.

entities.name: Codie
entities.description: A menacing sentient tome in the Folioplex holding dangerous arcane knowledge from across the Echoverse.

entities.name: Mage Hunters
entities.description: Vile spider-legged monsters that sense magic and swarm the Eradia.

entities.name: Witchstalkers
entities.description: Fearsome multicephalic wolves that hunt magic-users in packs and can scale the tower.

entities.name: Figments
entities.description: Faceless specters that wander Hexhaven's halls tethered to the Echoverse.

entities.name: Puppetbeasts
entities.description: Animated wood, stone and clay constructs piloted by Konstrari tethermages.

entities.name: Bolas
entities.description: A self-serving egoist who has no place in the Echoverse.

entities.name: The Eldrazi
entities.description: Monstrous beings absent from the Echoverse.

entities.name: The Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders absent from the Echoverse, whose invasion traumatized Jace.

entities.name: The Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion of the entire Multiverse that ignited the experiment.

entities.name: The Echoverse
entities.description: The Theorist's reproduction of every plane of the Multiverse, minus what he deemed too great an evil.

entities.name: Echoverse Arcavios
entities.description: The plane in the process of being born, home of Hexhaven Academy and the tower.

entities.name: Hexhaven Academy
entities.description: The regimented battlemage academy that is the Echoverse's equivalent of Strixhaven, forming the lower part of the tower.

entities.name: The Tower
entities.description: An immense, impossible tower over the largest leyline confluence, warped from Hexhaven's bell tower.

entities.name: The Eradia
entities.description: A wasteland nearly a hundred miles wide around the tower, crawling with mage-eating monsters.

entities.name: The Meditation Realm
entities.description: The realm where Jace was unmade and began constructing the new reality.

entities.name: Chamber of the Guildpact
entities.description: A place whose imaginary ruins hold Jace's former sanctum within a memory-prison.

entities.name: Vryn
entities.description: Jace's home plane, whose motifs echo through the tower.

entities.name: The Folioplex
entities.description: A dimly lit archive at the middle of the tower, tightly controlled by the Theorist.

entities.name: The School of Future History
entities.description: A Hexhaven school of divination and prophecy located at the base of the tower.

entities.name: The School of Esoteric Mathematics
entities.description: A Hexhaven school of impossible math and portals located near the top of the tower.

entities.name: The School of Painful Words
entities.description: A Hexhaven school of battlepoets who use emotion and words.

entities.name: The School of Constructive Arts
entities.description: A Hexhaven school of puppetbeast builders and tethermages.

entities.name: The School of Invasive Healing
entities.description: A Hexhaven school of healing by grafting plant matter into flesh.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The school whose equivalent in the Echoverse is Hexhaven.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The original plane whose creation by collision the Theorist studies.

events.summary: The guide introduces Jace's attempt to rewrite reality and the Echoverse.
events.quote: Jace Beleren, Planeswalker and mind-mage, is attempting to rewrite reality with his own vision for existence.

events.summary: Honest Jace, in a memory-prison, recounts the experiment born from trauma after the Phyrexian Invasion to build a Multiverse without monsters.
events.quote: An experiment ignited by our trauma after the Phyrexian Invasion of the entire Multiverse

events.summary: The original plan fails and Jace is unmade in the Meditation Realm, but pieces linger and rebuild him with the need to build a better Multiverse.
events.quote: When our original plan failed, Jace was unmade in the Meditation Realm.

events.summary: Jace's most stubborn self carves away the parts of himself that disagree, starting with the honest piece.
events.quote: He's even gone so far as to carve out the parts of himself that disagree with what he's done.

events.summary: Only the Theorist remains, erasing memories and puppeteering enemies without regard for free will.
events.quote: Now, the Theorist is all that remains

events.summary: The Theorist calculates probabilities and excises persons or events from planes' histories to build the Echoverse.
events.quote: the Theorist calculates probabilities and works to excise elements (a person, an event) from a plane's history.

events.summary: The Theorist plans to lay the Echoverse over the existing Multiverse by studying the creation of Arcavios.
events.quote: The only way to give it stability is to lay its skin atop the bones of the existing Multiverse.

events.summary: Harmonious mana on the Theorist's Arcavios creates five elder sphinxes and unified schools.
events.quote: harmonious mana merged, creating five elder sphinxes and inspiring schools that held unified perspectives.

events.summary: The Theorist takes up residence in Hexhaven's bell tower, warping the campus into the tower.
events.quote: He took up residence in the central bell tower

events.summary: His magic leaves a wasteland, the Eradia, around the tower.
events.quote: the Theorist's reality-bending magic left a wasteland surrounding it for nearly a hundred miles

events.summary: The sphinxes found Hexhaven Academy atop the leyline confluence to teach and protect the people of Arcavios.
events.quote: Hexhaven Academy was built on top of the large leyline confluence from which the sphinxes had emerged.

events.summary: Uldaros Theorix builds Hexhaven's original fortress to keep the campus from mage hunters.
events.quote: The elder sphinx Uldaros Theorix used his reality-bending magic to build the original fortress of Hexhaven

events.summary: Champions of different schools fail the accension trial in memorable ways.
events.quote: Every school has a story of a promising cadet who failed their accension trial.

events.summary: The Theorist interrupts the guide, silencing the narrator and ordering the reader to forget.
events.quote: You will forget what you have heard.

relations.note: The Theorist builds the Echoverse as a copy of the Multiverse.
relations.quote: To create a Multiverse free of pain and suffering

relations.note: Honest Jace is a piece of Jace the Theorist carved away.
relations.quote: I was the first. I was the part that was honest about who we are.

relations.note: The Theorist is a fragmented amalgamation of Jace's worse traits.
relations.quote: an amalgamation of our worse traits magnified, without any of the empathy that made us a leader

relations.note: Hexhaven is the Echoverse's equivalent of Strixhaven.
relations.quote: Hexhaven Academy, the equivalent of Strixhaven in the Echoverse.

relations.note: Denzilore founded the school and is its dean.
relations.quote: Denzilore Fatehold founded this school to improve the outlook for the denizens of Echoverse Arcavios.
the Theorix founder established the following magical laws to guide his school

relations.note: She composed canons for her followers and school.
relations.quote: Ingris Stingerquill composed the following canons for her followers and school

relations.note: They established tenets for their school.
relations.quote: they established the following tenets for their school

relations.note: After founding her school, she cultivated ethics and oaths.
relations.quote: After founding her school, she cultivated the following ethics and oaths for her followers

relations.note: Mage hunters attack Hexhaven and its mages.
relations.quote: keeping the campus out of reach of the mage hunters, which had grown bolder in their attacks.
